_comment: YouTube Music tracks the yt-dlp lane plays a few seconds of (components.yml, and radios after an upgrade). Each one is an official 'Provided to YouTube by <label>' art track on the artist's Topic channel: catalogue recordings decades old, from three different major labels, so one takedown or licence change can't fail them all. Edit freely; ytm_ids are 11-character video ids, min_bytes is how much audio must arrive (64 KiB = a few seconds).

titles.KJEzFvXx3Xw: Miles Davis - So What (Kind of Blue, Columbia/Legacy)
titles.kMJCKP-ETZ4: Glenn Gould - Goldberg Variations, BWV 988: Aria (Sony Classical)
titles.6cbFlkRu54I: Berliner Philharmoniker, Karajan - Beethoven: Symphony No. 5, I. Allegro con brio (Deutsche Grammophon / Universal)
